source: zeiss.co.in 'Need new lenses?' pages (ZEISS Vision Center Gomti Nagar page links) + zeiss.com DriveSafe & DuraVision pages. 'trigger' rules are Drishti Saathi's own, not ZEISS's. Always label output: 'Suggested ZEISS lens family - optician confirms'.
selection_order: 1. Red flag present -> NO lens suggestion, referral only (full check still runs, report always sent)
2. Pick LENS TYPE (single vision / anti-fatigue / progressive / myopia management)
3. Pick DESIGN within the type (ClearView / Light 2 / SmartLife / ClearMind / DriveSafe / SmartLife Young)
4. Add MATERIAL options (BlueGuard / PhotoFusion X); UVProtect always
6. Suggest up to 2 SECOND PAIRS (Office / DriveSafe / prescription sun)

lens_types.name: ZEISS Single Vision lenses
lens_types.who_for: Short-sighted (minus), long-sighted (plus) or astigmatism; one prescription over the whole lens; clear at one distance (far OR near). All-day or task-only (reading, driving).
lens_types.how_it_works: One power across the lens. Premium designs reduce blur/distortion toward the edges without extra thickness.
benefits: UV protection to 400 nm in clear lenses
limits: No help for near focus once eyes start ageing; ZEISS suggests a second pair (e.g. Office) if discomfort
lens_types.trigger: age < 30, OR age 30-44 without near/screen tiredness, AND no near add needed
lens_types.why_en: Your blur is at one distance ({distance}); one power fixes it.
lens_types.why_hi: आपको एक ही दूरी ({distance}) पर धुंधला दिखता है; एक पावर वाला लेंस यह ठीक करता है।

lens_types.name: ZEISS Anti-fatigue (Digital) lenses
lens_types.who_for: 30s to mid-40s; need distance glasses but struggle up close; tired eyes or blur at end of day / after near work; heavy screen users; difficulty switching near-far.
lens_types.how_it_works: Distance lens with a small near 'boost' in the lower part; gentle addition, smaller side blur than progressives.
benefits: Less eye strain and tiredness from screens/reading
Less blur than progressives, quick adaptation
Can ease later move to progressives
limits: Not enough near help once a full reading add is needed (then progressive)
lens_types.trigger: age 30-44 AND (screen hours >= 4 OR tired eyes/near blur >= sometimes) AND measured add < 0.75
lens_types.why_en: You are {age} and your eyes get tired after {screen_hours} h of screens; the small boost at the bottom eases phone-to-far switching.
lens_types.why_hi: आपकी उम्र {age} है और {screen_hours} घंटे स्क्रीन के बाद आँखें थकती हैं; लेंस के नीचे का हल्का बूस्ट फ़ोन से दूर देखने में आराम देता है।

lens_types.name: ZEISS Progressive lenses
lens_types.who_for: Middle-aged people who start having trouble focusing up close (ZEISS: common choice over 45); want one pair for all distances.
lens_types.how_it_works: Distance zone at top, intermediate in middle, near at bottom; no visible lines.
benefits: Far, middle and near in one pair
No swapping or separate reading glasses
limits: Learning curve; must look through correct zone
Narrow intermediate zone for long screen work (see Office)
lens_types.why_en: You need +{add} D extra for near; a progressive gives far, screen and reading in one pair.
lens_types.why_hi: पास के लिए आपको +{add} D अतिरिक्त चाहिए; प्रोग्रेसिव लेंस एक ही चश्मे में दूर, स्क्रीन और पढ़ना देता है।

lens_types.name: ZEISS Office lenses
lens_types.who_for: Most of the day at a computer / fixed work distances; eye strain even with current glasses; headaches or neck/shoulder pain from screen work (receptionists, accountants, designers).
lens_types.how_it_works: Personalised to workplace distances (examples: documents up to 100 cm, multiple screens up to 200 cm, room up to 3.2-4 m). Tech: Digital Inside (fewer head/eye movements), M.I.D (near-intermediate needs), FaceFit; optional BlueGuard, DuraVision.
benefits: Less eye, neck, back, shoulder strain
limits: Work pair only; switch to regular glasses at home / for driving
lens_types.trigger: desk/screen work hours >= 6 AND (age >= 40 OR neck pain/headache >= sometimes)
lens_types.why_en: You work {desk_hours} h at a screen and get {symptom}; an office pair keeps the screen sharp without tilting your head.
lens_types.why_hi: आप {desk_hours} घंटे स्क्रीन पर काम करते हैं और {symptom} होता है; ऑफिस लेंस सिर झुकाए बिना स्क्रीन साफ़ दिखाता है।

lens_types.name: ZEISS Myopia management lenses
lens_types.who_for: Children up to 12 with progressing myopia; under-7 myopes at higher risk of high myopia.

products.name: MyoCare
products.how: C.A.R.E. ring zones (myopic defocus) alternating 50:50 with correction zones; clear centre; ClearFocus back surface
products.claim: Eye growth ~70% closer to non-myopic children, ages 7-12 (ARVO 2024 abstract)

products.name: MyoKids
products.how: Lower zone manages accommodative lag during near work

products.name: MyoVision / Pro / Ace
products.how: Large clear centre + peripheral zone reducing peripheral defocus

lens_types.wearing: Works only if worn as much as possible; 2 h+ outdoor time daily, breaks from near work, limited screens; annual eye exam.
limits: An eye care professional decides; mostly manufacturer-supported evidence
lens_types.trigger: age < 18 AND any minus power (myopia) -> REFERRAL ONLY (tag CHILD_MYOPIA), never a lens choice; full check still runs and report is sent
lens_types.why_en: Your child's eyes are short-sighted; an optometrist can check if myopia-slowing lenses are needed.
lens_types.why_hi: आपके बच्चे की दूर की नज़र कमज़ोर है; ऑप्टोमेट्रिस्ट जाँच करेंगे कि नज़र बढ़ने से रोकने वाले लेंस चाहिए या नहीं।

designs.what: More clear area across the lens than conventional single vision; limited customisation; 1.60 index noted
Medium-wide fields, soft transitions; for first-time progressive wearers; fast adaptation
For connected, on-the-move lifestyles; clear at all distances and directions; customised to eyes, age, lifestyle
designs.trigger: budget = mid/high AND digital/mobile-heavy lifestyle (default premium)

designs.what: For concentration in visually busy environments; very clear, optimised blur zones, reduces cognitive load; 1 in 2 progressive wearers adapted within an hour (ZEISS 2025 survey)
designs.trigger: budget = high AND (busy visual work OR focus complaints)

designs.what: All-day lens optimised for driving; Luminance Design for pupil size in low light (dusk, fog, rain); large distance zone, intermediate for dashboard/mirrors, smaller near zone; DuraVision DriveSafe coating: up to 64% less perceived glare (one ZEISS test)
designs.trigger: drives daily/weekly AND (oncoming glare OR poor low-light vision >= sometimes)

designs.what: Designed for children's eyes, frames and lifestyle; more clear area than adult lenses
designs.trigger: age < 18 AND NOT myopic (myopic children -> referral only); label 'optometrist confirms'

materials.name: ZEISS UVProtect
materials.what: Absorbs UV up to 400 nm in all clear organic ZEISS lenses since 2018, no extra cost
materials.why_en: UV is linked to cataract and macular damage; up to 75% of UV exposure can happen on cloudy days.
materials.why_hi: धूप की UV किरणें मोतियाबिंद से जुड़ी हैं; बादल वाले दिन भी UV लगती है।

materials.name: ZEISS BlueGuard
materials.what: Blue-light blocking built into lens material (not a coating); blocks up to 40% of harmful blue light; fewer purple reflections; works with any ZEISS design; already inside PhotoFusion X
materials.limits: Not a cure; pair with 20-20-20 rule
materials.trigger: screen hours >= 4 OR digital strain symptoms >= sometimes
materials.why_en: You use screens {screen_hours} h a day and report {symptom}; BlueGuard cuts part of screen blue light with fewer reflections.
materials.why_hi: आप रोज़ {screen_hours} घंटे स्क्रीन देखते हैं; ब्लूगार्ड स्क्रीन की नीली रोशनी का हिस्सा रोकता है।

materials.name: ZEISS PhotoFusion X
materials.what: Self-tinting: darkens in UV (~15 s to glare protection), clears up to 2.5x faster than other brands; blocks up to 50% blue light indoors, 94% outdoors; full UV; many colours
materials.limits: Not activated by headlights/streetlights - no help with night glare; darkness varies with temperature/UV
materials.trigger: outdoor hours >= 2 AND wants one pair for indoor+outdoor (not instead of DriveSafe for night glare)
materials.why_en: You are outdoors {outdoor_hours} h a day; one pair that darkens in sun and clears indoors.
materials.why_hi: आप रोज़ {outdoor_hours} घंटे बाहर रहते हैं; यह लेंस धूप में गहरा और अंदर साफ़ हो जाता है।

coatings.name: DuraVision Plus Gold
coatings.what: Highest scratch resistance, fastest-cleaning top coat, subtle gold reflex

coatings.name: DuraVision Platinum
coatings.what: Highly scratch-resistant, up to 50% fewer reflections, faint blue reflex

coatings.name: DuraVision AntiVirus Platinum UV
coatings.what: Platinum-level anti-reflection/scratch resistance + antimicrobial surface + UV (shown in ZEISS My Vision Profile results)
coatings.trigger: budget = mid/high AND touches glasses often / public-facing work

coatings.name: DuraVision Silver
coatings.what: Clear, up to 50% fewer reflections, slightly less hard than Platinum

coatings.name: DuraVision Chrome
coatings.what: Standard DuraVision features, faint green reflex, lower price

coatings.name: DuraVision Plus DriveSafe
coatings.what: Reflects wavelengths that cause headlight/streetlight glare; scratch-resistant

coatings.name: DuraVision BlueProtect
coatings.what: Blue-light coating for computer use; ZEISS calls BlueGuard material the stronger option; redundant with BlueGuard

second_pair_sun.what: Cuts glare from road, water, snow; more contrast; full UV
second_pair_sun.trigger: drives in daytime OR water/outdoor sport OR field/farm work

second_pair_sun.what: Photochromic sun tints (solid/gradient); can add polarisation; blue tint not for driving
second_pair_sun.trigger: changing light, wants sunglasses that adapt

second_pair_sun.what: 50+ solid/gradient tints, full UV to 400 nm
DuraVision Mirror (bright extreme outdoors) / Flash (subtle mirror)
Absorbs up to 90% light; snow/water sports
